h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kohima

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kohima

c: Flat ground is scarce in Kohima, and that is the first thing we ask about when someone in Nagaland needs an outdoor gym equipment supplier. FunPlay Systems builds its Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2280 km from Kohima. The equipment travels by road to the north-east, where our installation team or a regional dealer fixes it on site.

Kohima is a hill capital with cool winters, mild summers and heavy rain through the monsoon. Many school grounds, colony terraces and viewpoints are narrow and sit on a slope. Single-user machines with a small footprint fit those spaces better than a large multi-station frame. Grouting is usually the right method on sloping or rocky ground, and we plan each footing on the layout drawing before anything is made.

richText.heading: Choosing machines for terraces and sloping sites

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be installed on a slope?
items.a: Yes, on a levelled pad. We usually grout each machine into a small concrete footing cut into the slope. Share photos of the site and we will mark the footings and the clear space on a layout drawing.
Yes. Equipment goes from our Vasai factory by road. A dealer from our network in the north-east or our own installation team handles the fixing once it reaches Kohima.

items.q: Which machines suit cold, wet weather?
items.a: Any of our galvanised machines can work in Kohima's climate. Simple stations such as pull-up bars, step trainers and twisters have few moving parts, so there is less to check after a long wet season.
